senses.definition: n.[m.] trusting, faithfulness (on format. cf. Ges§ 84 a R. 12).
בָּנִים לֹא אֵמֻן בָּם children in whom there is no trusting Dt 32:20 (poet.)

אֱמוּנִים pl. abst. faithfulness; צִיר א׳ messenger of faithfulness, trusty messenger Pr 13:17; עֵד א׳ faithful witness Pr 14:5; cf. אִישׁ א׳ Pr 20:6; שֹׁמֵר א׳ keeping faithfulness Is 26:2; perhaps also ψ 31:24 נצר א׳ v. I. [אָמַן].
